name: closet-organizer
description: A closet tower system in 18mm white melamine: 6 uprights 47-1/4" x 15-3/4" and 18 shelves 31-3/4" x 15-3/4". Melamine has no grain, so every part may turn. Hand-checked layout on usable 2430 x 1210, three 400mm rows per sheet: three rows of [upright x 2] = 2403, six rows of [shelf x 3] = 2424. Nine rows fill three sheets exactly, 2.8% waste at a perfect pack. Stresses high quantity and heavy repetition.
